messages:
carla_infra: Quick async check — Nimbus Health onprem rollout: we hit the network ACL gating on staging last night. Can owners confirm who's owning the egress fallback for their region?
frank_netops: I can do APAC egress fallback. Need the exact CIDR list from Nimbus net team to open the temporary tunnel.
dave_prod: thx Frank. I'm owner for NA. Will validate our smoke path once Frank confirms the tunnel.
carla_infra: @frank_netops and @dave_prod noted. @jules_security you flagged image signing earlier — is that blocker or optional for canary?
jules_security: Image signing is required for their air-gapped env per contract. We're only waiting on the signed manifest from build-prod pipeline. I pinged ben to prioritize.
ben_release: saw this. I re-ran the build with cosign; artifact uploaded to the customer bucket. Link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/nimbus/2026-02-12. Can someone verify pull from staging-airgap?
erin_sre: Will run the pull at 16:30 PT and report. Adding quick test script below to validate KV cache warming and inference startup:```bash
kubectl apply -f nimbus-smoke.yaml
sleep 20
kubectl logs deploy/infra-worker | tail -n 80
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health
```
carla_infra: Nice. Also: firewall rule 10.12.45.0/24 for metrics export still missing in their infra ticket (#NIM-482). @frank_netops can you escalate with the partner network engineer?
frank_netops: Escalated via email to their net-eng. Copying their responder: net-eng@nimbushealth.com. ETA for rule add = EOD tomorrow unless they need a change window.
dave_prod: If they can't do EOD, plan B is to spool metrics to s3 and ship from our side. Not ideal but keeps canary moving.
jenkins-deploy-bot: deploy queued: nimbus/staging/canary v1.3.2 — waiting on manual approval by carla_infra.
carla_infra: approving deploy now. :thumbsup: Running canary at 17:00 PT. Erin, please run the heatmap test (latency under 120ms p50) and paste results.
erin_sre: Can confirm pull succeeded. Startup logs look good but there's a repeated WARN about KMS key access in the first 30s. Jules, can you check KMS policy?
jules_security: KMS policy missing the decrypt:Grant entry for their service account — updating now. Pushed policy change, asking Nimbus to rotate the role binding.
frank_netops: small ask — their NAT48 gateway doesn't do hairpin, so the egress fallback needs to be a different subnet. I'll add details in the ticket.
dave_prod: noted. If that changes rollout plan we'll delay by 4 hours. Carla — ok to shift if net team needs a maintenance window?
carla_infra: We can shift up to 6 hours. Keep the timeline updated in #nimbus-rollout doc. Also please add a brief postmortem note if any workaround is used.
ben_release: FYI I opened a small PR to the deploy script to retry cosign download for flaky mirrors: https://git.internal/r/redwood/deploy/pulls/812 — tagging @carla_infra for quick review.
carla_infra: Thanks. Last ask: code-review ping to infra-ops for the updated mount permissions — will merge after one more 👍.
erin_sre: Canary results: p50=98ms, p95=220ms (KV warmup still in progress). No 500s in the last 30m. Sending logs to the ops channel.
carla_infra: Excellent. Closing the immediate blocker list: image signing ✅, pull ✅, smoke tests ✅, egress fallback pending (Frank) — action owners updated. We'll reconvene tomorrow AM if partner net change not in by midnight.
frank_netops: I'll follow up with Nimbus net-eng in the morning and loop infra.
dave_prod: I'll queue the broader rollout checklist once Frank confirms.
ben_release: merging the retry PR in ~10m.
deploy-bot: deploy success: nimbus/staging/canary v1.3.2 (commit f9a3b2)
carla_infra: Great work team. If anything urgent ping me directly. :sparkles:
